label: v254
changes: Teluva now uses the new white-and-coral wordmark consistently in the main navigation, onboarding and sign-in experience.
Family tree now has a direct Add a child action, so a parent never has to leave the tree to create the child’s profile.
New child profiles appear in the tree automatically, then Teluva opens the parent-and-child link with the child already selected.
Parent relationships are always confirmed by the family rather than guessed when a household has more than one possible parent.
A ready-to-use private-beta survey is included for consistent feedback alongside WhatsApp conversations.
